note: P4386 (Pro 31:9) — open your mouth, judge righteously, defend the rights of the poor and needy.

dims.v: just advocacy — speaking up and judging rightly for the voiceless

the righteous judging and defending of the rights of the poor and needy — the just advocacy that opens its mouth for the voiceless, using power to secure justice for those who cannot secure it themselves
the righteous use of authority to protect the defenceless

tsedeq (righteousness) — 'open your mouth, judge RIGHTEOUSLY, defend the rights of the poor and needy' (31:9); the crown of Lemuel's mother's counsel — power exists to protect the weak. Righteous rule speaks up for those who have no voice (cf 29:7, 14; 31:8).
